patches_added.name: Restore Source Selection
patches_added.description: Returns the source picker to the source played before leaving the player.

patches_added.name: Into the Dead Ad Removal
patches_added.description: Removes all ads and grants rewarded-video rewards instantly: rewarded videos (legacy IronSource and LevelPlay), interstitials, launch, banner and AdMob App Open ads are all eliminated.

patches_added.name: Into the Dead Billing Bypass
patches_added.description: Unlocks all in-app purchases for free and bypasses SHA1withRSA receipt verification: every store item is granted instantly without launching the Google Play payment dialog, and any fabricated receipt is accepted.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Free IAP
patches_removed.description: Unlocks all in-app purchases for free: every store item is granted instantly without launching the Google Play payment dialog.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Instant Rewards
patches_removed.description: Skips rewarded video ads (legacy IronSource path): the reward is granted immediately without showing the ad.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Instant Rewards (LevelPlay)
patches_removed.description: Skips rewarded video ads (new LevelPlayRewardedAd API): the reward is granted immediately without showing the ad.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Remove Ads
patches_removed.description: Removes interstitial, launch and banner ads (legacy IronSource bridge): the C# interstitial-ready signal is killed, readiness polls return false, explicit loads are no-ops, and any show call completes the C# lifecycle instantly without displaying an ad.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Remove Ads (LevelPlay)
patches_removed.description: Safety nets for the new LevelPlay API: InterstitialAd.loadAd/showAd and BannerAd.load/showAd become no-ops and isAdReady returns false, so no interstitial or banner can ever display through the new API.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Remove App Open Ad
patches_removed.description: Removes the AdMob App Open full-screen ad (the one shown on the second launch): the load, show, pollAd preloader and lifecycle-trigger entry points on the com.google.unity.ads bridge all become no-ops, so an app open ad can never load or display.

patches_removed.name: Into the Dead Verify Bypass
patches_removed.description: Bypasses SHA1withRSA purchase receipt verification so fabricated purchase receipts are accepted.

patches_modified.name: Use your own Maps API key [REQUIRED]
patches_modified.description: Required for maps and exact-address search. Patching breaks Moovit's built-in Google Maps Platform key, so supply your own from a Google Cloud project. Enable Maps SDK for Android, Places API (New), and Geocoding API, turn on billing, create an API key, and paste it in (leaving it unrestricted is easiest). Remove ads and Unlock Moovit+ both pull this in.
